messages:
samuel-sales: FYI - GridPay POC: must keep customer data confined to EU-North-1 (no cross-border control plane), BYOK via their HSM appliance, 10yr audit log retention, and they want confirmation that any edge relays or telemetry never contain user payloads. Can presales/ops/sec/legal confirm feasibility and pricing impact?

anya-presales: We can do EU-only with Dedicated or Private. Hosted won't support customer HSM appliances. Clarify: do they expect active-active across EU zones or single-region active with disaster recovery offline? That affects standby capacity. Also asked about egress credits if we need to route across peering links.

mike-ops: Technical ops: tenant_pin to eu-north-1 + disable cross-region failover is doable. KV/prefix cache must be local-only. Example minimal policy we use: 
```yaml
route_policy:
  tenant_pin: true
  allowed_regions: [eu-north-1]
  fallback_policy: none
  cache_mode: local_only
```
Note: local_only cache increases cold starts and removes cross-region batching efficiency. We'll need VPC peering/private-link and their ASN for BGP setup.

leah-security: Security notes: BYOK appliance requires Private control plane or on-prem bundle. Key-wrap handshake needs an HSM admin contact and signed KMS SLA. Telemetry: we can toggle telemetry to redact user payloads and retain only metadata in EU; full payloads will never be sent. 10yr retention is unusual; legal will need to confirm. Send the security questionnaire and their DPA comments.

legal-bot: New legal request: QUE-4721 created for subprocessor disclosure + 10yr retention addendum. Requires Legal review and countersign.

anya-presales: Pricing sketch: Dedicated EU-only pool with HSM integration -> ~+25% baseline. One-time HSM integration & runbook: $3.5k. Ongoing key ops/audit support: $1.2k/mo. Extended log retention add-on: $400/mo per TB. Exact quote after QPS/token + retention estimate.

samuel-sales: I'll ask GridPay to confirm active-active vs single-region, provide network diagram and HSM ops contact, and complete the security questionnaire. Can we tentatively schedule tech + legal sync Wed 09:30 CET?

mike-ops: I'll prepare peering checklist, BGP config snippet, and a short ops runbook for DB snapshots and KV cache locality.

leah-security: I'll prepare the telemetry redaction options and draft the BYOK key-wrap flow for their HSM appliance.

anya-presales: I'll draft the Dedicated+BYOK proposal and include the log retention line item.

samuel-sales: Great. Action items assigned. :thumbsup:
